footer.tagline: A free service to help you find benefits, procedures and support organisations near you.
footer.verified: Every record cites its source. It is shown as checked only after a dated automatic check against its official source.
footer.project: AccesDirectAide — a non-profit association project, being set up under the local law of Alsace-Moselle.
footer.coverage: Area covered: <0>Eurométropole de Strasbourg</0> for local information, and national benefits.

error.notFoundText: The address you entered may be incorrect, or the page has been moved.
error.temporaryText: A technical error prevents this page from being displayed. Try again in a few moments.
crash.title: An error occurred
crash.text: We are sorry, an unexpected error occurred. Reload the page or go back to the home page; if the error happens again, report it from the Contact page.
crash.support: If the problem continues, contact us at <0>support@accesdirectaide.fr</0>
beta.banner: Public beta · Benefits, procedures and support centres checked against official sources. Accounts, appointments and documents: not open yet. Only the organisation concerned decides on your rights.
beta.closed.title: This feature is not open yet
beta.closed.intro: Accès Direct Aide is in public beta. During this phase, you can consult the checked benefits, procedures and support centres, with their official sources.
beta.closed.later: Creating an account, the personal area, booking appointments, sharing a file, sending documents and the contact forms will open later, once the data protection safeguards are in place. Nothing is asked of you here: only technical data is processed (IP address in the host’s logs, security cookie), as explained on the <0>Privacy</0> page.
beta.closed.contact: For a question or to report an error, write to us at <0>{{email}}</0>. Do not write sensitive personal information (health, social security number, documents).
cookies.label: Information about cookies
cookies.beta: AccesDirectAide only uses necessary cookies and storage: securing forms and keeping your display settings. During the public beta, we do not measure audience.
cookies.necessary: AccesDirectAide only uses necessary cookies and storage: keeping you signed in, securing forms, keeping your display settings. We do not measure audience.
cookies.audience: AccesDirectAide only uses necessary cookies and storage: keeping you signed in, securing forms, keeping your display settings. We also measure audience, for our own use only, and record technical errors. You can object to this.
update.text: A new version of AccesDirectAide is available. Remember to finish what you are typing first.
